_meta.purpose: Annotated English source catalogue for Enisma. Every leaf is { message, context }. `message` is the English text; `context` tells a translator where it appears and how it is used.
rules: Return the same JSON shape with `message` translated. Leave keys, structure, and `context` untouched.
Text in {braces} is a runtime placeholder. Keep the placeholder name exactly; move it wherever the target language's word order requires.

{count, plural, ...} is ICU MessageFormat. Replace the English `one`/`other` categories with whatever categories the target language actually uses (`zero`, `one`, `two`, `few`, `many`, `other`). `#` prints the number.
Entries whose context says DO NOT TRANSLATE must be copied through unchanged.
Keyboard shortcut text (Ctrl, Shift, F11) is generated by the app and is not in this file.
These are UI labels in a desktop app. Prefer short. Where a button label is long enough to wrap, say so rather than inventing an abbreviation.

name.context: DO NOT TRANSLATE. The product name, shown in the library sidebar next to the logo.

newProject.context: Primary button at the top of the library sidebar. Opens a file picker to import a PDF.

library.context: Small uppercase heading above the filter list in the sidebar. A section label, not an action.

allProjects.context: Sidebar filter. Shows every project. Has a count beside it.

recent.context: Sidebar filter. Projects touched in the last 24 hours.

inProgress.context: Sidebar filter. Projects with some but not all pages finished.

completed.context: Sidebar filter. Projects where every page is finished.

settings.context: Sidebar button at the bottom. Opens the app settings dialog.

heading.context: Main page heading on the library screen.

subtitle.context: Under the heading. Used when there is no recent activity to report.

subtitleWithActivity.message: {count, plural, one {# ፕሮጀክት} other {# ፕሮጀክቶች}} · የመጨረሻ እንቅስቃሴ {time}
subtitleWithActivity.context: Under the heading. {time} is an already-translated relative time such as '5 minutes ago' from the `time` section below. Duplicated from `subtitle` on purpose: the two halves must be translated as one sentence, not glued together at runtime.

search.context: Placeholder text inside the search box. Note the single-character ellipsis.

view.context: Button that opens a dropdown of sorting and filtering options. A noun ('the view'), not the verb 'to view'.

sortBy.context: Heading inside the View dropdown, above the sort choices.

sortTitle.context: Sort option. Alphabetical by book title.

sortProgress.context: Sort option. By how much of the book is finished.

show.context: Heading inside the View dropdown, above visibility toggles.

showCompleted.context: Checkbox in the View dropdown. When ticked, finished projects stay visible in the grid.

newTileTitle.context: Heading on the dashed placeholder tile in the project grid.

newTileBody.context: Supporting line under 'Start a new project'. A full sentence.

dropAccept.context: Shown inside a dashed overlay across the whole library while a PDF is being dragged over the window, before it is dropped. Confirms dropping it here will import it.

dropReject.context: Shown inside the same overlay when the file being dragged over the library is not a PDF. Explains why nothing will happen if it is dropped.

moreOptions.context: Screen-reader label for the '…' button on a project card.

pages.context: On a project card: how many pages are finished out of the total. 'pp' is the English abbreviation for 'pages'. Use your language's equivalent short form, or drop it if there isn't one — space is tight.

rename.context: Menu item in the '…' menu on a project card. Opens a dialog to change the project's title. Keep it short — it sits in a narrow menu.

delete.context: Menu item in the '…' menu on a project card. Destructive; opens a confirmation dialog. Keep it short — it sits in a narrow menu.

done.context: Badge on a project card. Every page is finished.

inProgress.context: Badge on a project card. Some pages finished.

new.context: Badge on a project card. No pages finished yet.

title.context: Title of the dialog shown after the user picks a PDF file.

fieldTitle.context: Field label above a text input. The name the book will have in the library.

fieldLanguage.context: Field label above a dropdown. The language the textbook is written in — this decides the text-to-speech voice, not the app's interface language.

cancel.context: Button. Dismisses the import dialog without creating anything.

confirm.context: Confirm button. A verb — the action of bringing the book in.

importing.context: Replaces the Import button label while the file is being copied. Note the single-character ellipsis.

extracting.context: Replaces the Import button label while the PDF's text is being extracted, before the project is created. Takes about a second. Note the single-character ellipsis.

scannedWarning.message: ይህ PDF የተቃኘ ይመስላል — ከ{total} ገጾች {empty} የጽሑፍ ንብርብር የላቸውም። Enisma እስካሁን የተቃኘ ጽሑፍ ማንበብ ስለማይችል፣ አብዛኞቹ ገጾች ባዶ ይሆናሉ።
scannedWarning.context: Warning inside the import dialog, shown before the project is created. {empty} and {total} are page counts. The user can still choose to import.

importAnyway.context: Button. Confirms importing a PDF that appears to be scanned, accepting that most pages will be empty.

title.context: Title of the app settings dialog.

appearance.context: Small uppercase section heading above the light/dark theme choices.

themeLight.context: Theme option name. Shown on a card with an icon.

themeLightHint.context: One-line explanation under the 'Light' theme option.

themeDark.context: Theme option name. Shown on a card with an icon.

themeDarkHint.context: One-line explanation under the 'Dark' theme option.

themeSystem.context: Theme option name. Follows the operating system's setting.

themeSystemHint.context: One-line explanation under the 'System' theme option. 'the desktop' means the operating system.

language.context: Small uppercase section heading above the interface-language dropdown. This is the app's own language, not the textbook's.

notTranslated.context: Appended after a language name in the dropdown when that language has no translation yet. Keep the leading space and the middle dot.

file.context: Top-level menu name in the window's title bar.

edit.context: Top-level menu name in the window's title bar.

view.context: Top-level menu name in the window's title bar.

backToLibrary.context: File menu item. Leaves the editor and returns to the project list.

importPdf.context: File menu item. Opens a file picker. The ellipsis signals that a dialog follows — keep it.

exportAudiobook.context: File menu item, currently always disabled. The ellipsis signals that a dialog follows — keep it.

quit.context: File menu item. Closes the application.

undo.context: Edit menu item. Reverses the last typing action in a text field.

redo.context: Edit menu item. Reapplies an undone action.

find.context: Edit menu item. Opens the find bar to search the current page's text.

findInBook.context: Edit menu item. Opens a search across every page of the book.

savePage.context: Edit menu item. Writes the current page's corrected text to disk.

markPageDone.context: Edit menu item with a tick when active. Flags the current page as finished being corrected.

cut.context: Edit menu item. Standard clipboard action.

copy.context: Edit menu item. Standard clipboard action.

paste.context: Edit menu item. Standard clipboard action.

togglePageList.context: View menu item. Shows or hides the left panel listing the book's pages.

toggleSettingsPanel.context: View menu item. Shows or hides the right panel with voice settings.

zoomIn.context: View menu item. Enlarges the PDF page.

zoomOut.context: View menu item. Shrinks the PDF page.

resetZoom.context: View menu item. Returns the PDF to 100%.

fullscreen.context: View menu item with a tick when active. Makes the window cover the whole screen.

minimise.context: Tooltip and screen-reader label on the window's minimise button.

maximise.context: Tooltip and screen-reader label on the window's maximise button.

restore.context: Replaces 'Maximise' once the window is already maximised. Returns it to its previous size.

close.context: Tooltip and screen-reader label on the window's close button.

pdfPreview.context: Shows only the scanned page, hiding the text editor. Appears both as a View-menu item and as a tooltip on the editor toolbar.

sideBySide.context: Shows the scanned page and the editable text next to each other. Appears both as a menu item and as a toolbar tooltip.

extractedText.context: Shows only the editable text, hiding the scan. Appears both as a menu item and as a toolbar tooltip.

bookTitle.context: Screen-reader label for the editable title field floating above the editor.

showLeftPanel.context: Tooltip on the toggle that reopens the page list on the left.

hideLeftPanel.context: Tooltip on the toggle that collapses the page list on the left.

showRightPanel.context: Tooltip on the toggle that reopens the voice settings on the right.

hideRightPanel.context: Tooltip on the toggle that collapses the voice settings on the right.

panelToggleTooltip.context: Wraps one of the four panel labels above with its keyboard shortcut. {shortcut} is generated by the app, e.g. 'Ctrl+\'. Adjust the punctuation if your language brackets differently.

previousPage.context: Tooltip and screen-reader label on the up-arrow button in the page stepper. The ↑ is the keyboard key that does the same thing — keep it.

nextPage.context: Tooltip and screen-reader label on the down-arrow button in the page stepper. The ↓ is the keyboard key that does the same thing — keep it.

goToPage.context: Tooltip and screen-reader label on the small number input between the two arrows. Typing a number jumps to that page.

loadError.context: Shown in place of the text editor when a page's stored text cannot be read. {page} is a page number, {error} is an untranslated technical message.

emptyText.message: እስካሁን የተወሰደ ጽሑፍ የለም — እዚህ ይተይቡ፣ ወይም ጽሑፉ እስኪወጣ ይጠብቁ።
emptyText.context: Faint placeholder inside the empty text editor when the editor is empty and nothing is coming to fill it — either the page was extracted and the user cleared the text, or extraction never ran and no re-extraction is under way. Tells the user their two options: type the text themselves, or wait for automatic extraction to fill it in.

stats.message: {words, plural, one {# ቃል} other {# ቃላት}} · ~{seconds}ሰ ንግግር
stats.context: Footer under the text editor. {seconds} is an estimate of how long the text takes to read aloud; 's' abbreviates seconds and '~' means approximately.

notLoaded.context: Appended to the footer in a warning colour when the page's text failed to load. Lowercase: it continues the line before it.

saveFailed.context: Appended to the footer in a warning colour when the last edit to this page could not be written to disk. Nothing retries on its own; the next keystroke re-sends the whole page, which is what the second half tells the user. Lowercase: it continues the line before it.

undoHint.context: Label next to a keyboard-shortcut chip in the editor footer. A reminder, not a button.

redoHint.context: Label next to a keyboard-shortcut chip in the editor footer. A reminder, not a button.

pageDone.context: Toggle button in the editor footer. Very tight on space — keep it short.

pageDoneTooltipOn.message: ገጹ ተጠናቋል — መልሰው ለመክፈት ጠቅ ያድርጉ
pageDoneTooltipOn.context: Tooltip on the 'Page done' button when the page is already marked finished.

pageDoneTooltipOff.context: Tooltip on the 'Page done' button when the page is not yet marked finished.

noTextLayer.message: ይህ ገጽ የጽሑፍ ንብርብር የለውም፣ ስለዚህ የሚወሰድ ጽሑፍ የለም። Enisma እስካሁን የተቃኘ ጽሑፍ ማንበብ አይችልም — ይህን ገጽ እዚህ መተየብ ይችላሉ።
noTextLayer.context: Faint placeholder inside the empty text editor, shown when extraction ran and found no text on this page — typically a scanned page. Should make clear this is expected, not a failure, and that typing is the way forward.

extracting.context: Faint placeholder inside the empty text editor while extraction is filling in a project that was missing its text. Brief and rare. Note the single-character ellipsis.

repairError.message: Enisma የዚህን መጽሐፍ ጽሑፍ እንደገና ማንበብ አልቻለም፦ {error}
repairError.context: Shown under the text editor when re-reading this book's text failed. {error} is an untranslated technical message. 'Enisma' is the app name and stays as-is.

renderError.context: Shown in place of the page image when the PDF cannot be drawn. {error} is an untranslated technical message.

resetZoom.context: Tooltip on the zoom-percentage badge in the corner of the PDF. Clicking it returns to 100%. {shortcut} is generated by the app.

done.context: Label on a counter tile in the page list. Number of pages finished. Clicking it filters the list.

notDone.context: Label on a counter tile in the page list. Number of pages still to correct. Clicking it filters the list.

pageAbbrev.context: Row label in the page list, e.g. 'p. 12'. 'p.' is the English abbreviation for 'page'. Use your language's short form; the column is narrow.

sectionLabel.context: Small uppercase label at the top of the right-hand panel in the editor.

heading.context: Heading under 'Audio settings'. The technology that reads text aloud in a synthetic voice.

subtitle.message: በዚህ ፕሮጀክት ውስጥ ባሉ ሁሉም ገጾች ላይ ተተግብሯል።
subtitle.context: Explains that the voice settings below are per-project, not per-page. A full sentence.

language.context: Field label above a dropdown. The textbook's language, which decides which voices are offered.

voice.context: Field label above a dropdown of synthetic speaker voices.

speakingRate.context: Field label above a slider controlling how fast the voice reads, from 0.5× to 2.0×.

page.context: Small uppercase label above the audio preview card, naming which page is being previewed.

toStart.context: Tooltip and screen-reader label on the button that jumps to the start of this page's audio.

back.context: Tooltip and screen-reader label on the button that jumps back a few seconds in the audio. {seconds} is a number, currently 5.

forward.context: Tooltip and screen-reader label on the button that jumps forward a few seconds in the audio. {seconds} is a number, currently 5.

toEnd.context: Tooltip and screen-reader label on the button that jumps to the end of this page's audio.

play.context: Screen-reader label on the round play button. Starts the sample audio.

pause.context: Replaces 'Play preview' while the sample audio is playing.

convert.context: Button that synthesizes the current page. Takes 40-100 seconds, so it is deliberately explicit rather than automatic.

converting.context: Shown in the audio panel while a page is being converted. {n} is the page being converted, which may not be the page on screen: other pages can be read and edited meanwhile.

cancel.context: Stops a conversion that is in progress.

cancelling.context: Replaces the Cancel button after it is pressed. The engine only checks for a stop between chunks, so this can last up to a minute.

stale.context: Badge on the audio player meaning the audio was made before the current text or settings. The audio still plays.

noText.message: በዚህ ገጽ ላይ የሚነበብ ነገር የለም።
noText.context: Replaces the Convert button when the page has no text at all.

convertError.context: Shown when a conversion fails. {error} is the untranslated message from the engine.

retry.context: Button beside a conversion error that starts the conversion over.

audioLoadError.message: Enisma የዚህን ገጽ ድምፅ መጫን አልቻለም፦ {error}
audioLoadError.context: Shown under the audio player when this page's saved audio could not be loaded or played. {error} is a technical message in English and is shown as-is.

position.context: Screen-reader label on the waveform, which can be clicked to jump to a point in the audio.

heading.context: Title of the card shown in place of the Convert button when this book's language has no usable voice model. {language} is a language name like 'Amharic'.

missing.message: የዚህ መጽሐፍ ድምጽ እስኪጫን ድረስ ጮክ ብሎ ሊነበብ አይችልም — {total} ማውረድ፣ አንድ ጊዜ ብቻ የሚያስፈልግ።
missing.context: Explains why the page cannot be read aloud yet. {total} is a download size like '114 MB'. A full sentence.

partial.message: ከ{total} ውስጥ {already} አስቀድሞ አለ። መቀጠል ካቆመበት ይጀምራል።
partial.context: Shown when an earlier download stopped part-way. {already} and {total} are sizes like '43 MB' and '114 MB'. Reassures the user the rest is all that is left.

unloadable.message: ድምጹ ተጭኗል ነገር ግን ሊጫን አልቻለም። እንደገና መጫን መሞከር ተገቢ ነው።
unloadable.context: Shown when the model files are all present and verified but the engine still failed to load them. Reinstalling is the only thing the user can usefully try.

failed.context: Shown under the card when installing failed. {error} is an untranslated technical message from the backend, such as a checksum failure or the names of files a folder was missing.

installing.context: Shown while the voice model is downloading or being copied in. {language} is a language name.

installingSize.context: Small caption beside the progress bar giving the total download size, e.g. '114 MB in total'.

download.context: Button that starts downloading this language's voice model.

resume.context: Replaces 'Download' when an earlier download stopped part-way and will continue from there.

reinstall.context: Replaces 'Download' when the files are present but the engine could not load them.

import.context: Button that opens a folder picker to install the voice model from files the user already has, instead of downloading.

importTooltip.message: አስቀድመው ካለዎት አቃፊ ይጫኑ — ግንኙነት ለሌለው ማሽን።
importTooltip.context: Tooltip on the 'From folder' button. Explains the offline route for a machine that cannot download.

cancel.context: Stops an install in progress. What has already downloaded is kept, so resuming later does not start over.

cancelling.context: Replaces 'Cancel' after it is pressed, while the install is still settling.

en.context: A textbook's language, listed in the import dialog and the voice panel. This is a language NAME shown in the app's current interface language — so translate it.

am.context: A textbook's language. Translate the name of the language itself.

ti.context: A textbook's language. Translate the name of the language itself. English spelling is deliberately 'Tigrigna', not 'Tigrinya'.

om.context: A textbook's language. Translate the name of the language itself.

en.context: DO NOT TRANSLATE. Interface-language option, deliberately shown in its own language so a user who cannot read the current interface can still find theirs.

am.context: DO NOT TRANSLATE. Interface-language option: the endonym followed by the English name.

ti.context: DO NOT TRANSLATE. Interface-language option: the endonym followed by the English name.

om.context: DO NOT TRANSLATE. Interface-language option: the endonym followed by the English name.

justNow.context: Relative time, under a minute ago. Lowercase: it is embedded mid-sentence, e.g. 'last activity just now', and also stands alone on a project card.

minutesAgo.message: {count, plural, one {ከ# ደቂቃ በፊት} other {ከ# ደቂቃዎች በፊት}}
minutesAgo.context: Relative time. Lowercase; may appear mid-sentence or alone.

hoursAgo.message: {count, plural, one {ከ# ሰዓት በፊት} other {ከ# ሰዓታት በፊት}}
hoursAgo.context: Relative time. Lowercase; may appear mid-sentence or alone.

yesterday.context: Relative time, used for anything 24–48 hours ago. Lowercase.

daysAgo.message: {count, plural, one {ከ# ቀን በፊት} other {ከ# ቀናት በፊት}}

weeksAgo.message: {count, plural, one {ከ# ሳምንት በፊት} other {ከ# ሳምንታት በፊት}}
weeksAgo.context: Relative time, two weeks or more. Lowercase. There is no month or year tier — long-dormant projects say '40 weeks ago'.

title.context: Heading of the dialog that changes a project's title.

field.context: Label above the text box holding the project's new title.

cancel.context: Button. Closes the rename dialog without changing anything.

confirm.context: Button. Saves the new project title. Disabled until the title has visible text and actually differs from the current one.

title.context: Heading of the confirmation dialog shown before a project is deleted.

body.message: “{title}”ን እና የ Enisma የ PDF ቅጂ ይሰርዛል። ዋናው ፋይልዎ አይነካም። ይህ መልሶ አይታደስም።
body.context: Body of the delete confirmation dialog. {title} is the project's own title. Must make clear that this cannot be undone and that only Enisma's own copy of the PDF is removed — the user's original file is untouched.

cancel.context: Button. Closes the delete dialog and keeps the project.

confirm.context: Button. Permanently deletes the project. Destructive — this is the point of no return.

american.context: Accent of an English voice, shown after the voice's name in the voice picker, e.g. 'Heart · American · Female'. An adjective describing the voice.

british.context: Accent of an English voice, shown after the voice's name in the voice picker, e.g. 'George · British · Male'. An adjective describing the voice.

female.context: Gender of a voice, shown after its name in the voice picker, e.g. 'Heart · American · Female'. An adjective describing the voice.

male.context: Gender of a voice, shown after its name in the voice picker, e.g. 'Abebe · Male'. An adjective describing the voice.

am.context: A man's given name, used as the name of the single Amharic voice. Transliterate the name Abebe (አበበ) into the interface language's script; do not translate it.

ti.context: A man's given name, used as the name of the single Tigrigna voice. Transliterate the name Tesfay (ተስፋይ) into the interface language's script; do not translate it.

om.context: A man's given name, used as the name of the single Afaan Oromoo voice. Transliterate the name Gemechu (ገመቹ / Gammachuu) into the interface language's script; do not translate it.

placeholder.context: Placeholder and screen-reader label of the find bar that searches the page being edited (Ctrl+F).

count.context: Shown beside the find field: which match is selected and how many the page has, e.g. '3 of 12'.

none.context: Shown beside the find field when the page has no match.

previous.context: Tooltip on the find bar's button that selects the previous match.

next.context: Tooltip on the find bar's button that selects the next match.

close.context: Tooltip on the find bar's close button.

placeholder.context: Placeholder and label of the floating book-wide search (Ctrl+Shift+F).

summary.context: Shown beside the search field: how many matches, across how many pages. {count} and {pages} are numbers.

none.message: በዚህ መጽሐፍ ውስጥ ምንም ውጤት የለም
none.context: Shown when nothing in the book matches the search.

page.context: Heading over a page's matches in the book search results. {n} is the page number.

loading.context: Shown briefly while the book's text is read for searching.

error.message: Enisma የዚህን መጽሐፍ ጽሑፍ ማንበብ አልቻለም፦ {error}
error.context: Shown when the book's text could not be read for searching. {error} is a technical message in English and is shown as-is.

hint.message: የዚህን መጽሐፍ ገጾች በሙሉ ለመፈለግ ይተይቡ
hint.context: Shown in the empty book search window before anything is typed. An instruction.
